redfin.remarks: Welcome home to this sun-drenched corner-unit residence tucked into one of Hollywood’s most vibrant and convenient pockets. Beautifully renovated from top to bottom, this turnkey 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom layout is meticulously designed for effortless modern living and relaxed entertaining. Step inside to an inviting open-concept floor plan washed in natural light, featuring sleek contemporary flooring, elevated fixtures, and fully refreshed bath and kitchen environments that feel instantly like home. Beyond your private retreat, experience a lifestyle unique to LA: step right out back to direct hiking trail access leading straight toward the iconic Hollywood Sign and Griffith Park. Additional high-value conveniences include two assigned tandem parking spaces, private storage , and HOA-covered water and trash utilities. Positioned with rapid access to both the 101 and 134 freeways, you are under 20 minutes from major entertainment studios, the Hollywood Bowl, top dining destinations, and legendary local landmarks.
